name: YESNO Speech Dataset
description: The YESNO Speech Dataset (OpenSLR 1) is a compact acoustic dataset designed for introductory automatic speech recognition and speech processing experiments. It consists of 60 audio recordings of an individual speaker pronouncing sequences of eight Hebrew words representing yes (ken) or no (lo), sampled at 8 kHz.
